class_guess: Sync bouncer counter: TM4 binary counter + 3-block bouncer with moving front
summary: TM4's binary counter + 00111/10111 block bouncer; 7 phase rules validated; parity branch, both branches safe
mechanism: Left: TM4's binary counter, k bits MSB first (1=1010, 0=0010), +1 per bounce.
Right: A blocks 00111, one 111 marker (the front), B blocks 10111. P phase: each bounce adds a B block.
Overflow: counter gains a bit; the front moves right 2 A blocks per visit; on reaching B, all B blocks become A blocks.

template.note: Left counter carries over (same d1/d0 digits; TM37's overflow form reached 5/5). Right side doesn't: TM4's BigStep holds 2/8, only when F0 is never read.

strategy:
Longitudinal proof in TM4 style: reuse the counter lemma (BC.Mul2/BC.Incs on d0/d1), add new segRLs lemmas for 00111/10111/111 words, prove R1-R5o with es/ind/follow.
Then progress_nonhalt_cond with a linear invariant on (n, X, z)/2^k that holds for both parity branches.
init: c0 -->* Q(5,17,1,2,2) at step 1507 by esx.
risks: Branch = parity of X (X grows ~3X/2: Collatz-like); proof needs an invariant valid for both branches (holds numerically under adversarial branching to k=600).
R5o (odd end + overflow) has front and conversion running at once: hardest low-level lemma.
Outside the regime (x+z >> 2^k) the head breaks through the counter and can halt; the invariant must exclude this.
